router_id.description: Default router ID for all neighbors that don’t specify their own.

neighbors.description: List of BGP neighbors to configure.

ip.description: IP address of the BGP peer.

peer_as.description: Autonomous system number of the peer.

router_id.description: Router ID for this specific neighbor (optional). If omitted, uses the global `router_id`.

connect_retry.description: Time in seconds to wait before retrying a failed connection.

in_filter.description: List of import filter rules (type: 'allow', 'deny', or 'community'); policy: e.g., 'accept', 'reject', or community match.

policy.description: Policy action — 'accept', 'reject', or a community match pattern.

out_filter.description: List of export filter rules (same structure as `in_filter`).

policy.description: Policy action — 'accept', 'reject', or a community match pattern.

graceful_restart.description: Enable BGP graceful restart for this neighbor (RFC 4724).

passive.description: Enable passive mode — only accept incoming connections (do not initiate).

static_routes.description: List of static routes to announce via ExaBGP.

next_hop.description: Next-hop IP address for the route.

api.description: ExaBGP API configuration for programmatic control.

enabled.description: Enable the ExaBGP API (required for external control via JSON/HTTP).

fork.description: Fork child processes for API handlers (recommended for isolation).

threads.description: Number of threads for API handlers.
